scope: Synthetic evidence review and human oversight demo; no operational validation

items.requirement: Large input and human review workload
items.implementation: case_003 expanded to 240 synthetic objects; one load scenario; paginated evidence review queue. Counts are workload assumptions, not measured attacks.

items.requirement: Phones and facilities as many sensors
items.implementation: 240 logical endpoints, grouped health and time-gated outage/recovery telemetry. No phone app, audio collection, edge inference or physical sensor detection linkage.
Existing separate civilian early-signal feed and opt-in current-alert PWA notifications while open/minimized. No external recipient, SMS, closed-app push or agency integration.
Kept local architecture and existing host/origin checks; no new authentication or security platform.

items.requirement: Agents assess the overall received situation
items.implementation: Situation assessment with OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol through Deep Agents, received-only evidence tools, validated citations and explicit offline rules mode. Credentialed synthetic-case smoke test passed; no operational validation or automated action.

items.requirement: Bound scope and distinguish rules from model reasoning
items.implementation: Three demo cases retained. Categorical explanations computed from inputs; rule and LLM assessment modes visibly distinguished.

items.requirement: Separate detection from identity/intent and outage cause
items.implementation: Identity and intent unknown; sensor loss cause unknown; corroboration, conflict and incomplete input separated; no calibrated probability claim.

items.requirement: Separate public context from physical observations
items.implementation: Separate received situation/context panels; agent excludes expired notices and never treats context as physical detection. No live public-source collection.

items.requirement: Human decision and versioned evidence audit
items.implementation: Track review captures self-entered reviewer alias, decision, reason, replay and wall time, received-evidence snapshot and hash; local append-only JSONL export. Alias is not authenticated identity.

items.requirement: Do not claim validated response outcomes
items.implementation: No response selection or operational intervention model; synthetic narrative and measured software checks are distinguished.

Synthetic unit/integration tests cover agreement/conflict/missing/stale/context/delayed receipts/review/replay. User-selected three cases supersede recommendation to restore twelve presentation cases.

items.requirement: Fictional airfield and qualified provenance claims
items.implementation: Generic synthetic geometry and current licensed assets retained; no universal standard compliance, typical-runway or blanket image-rights claims. Detailed airfield geometry remains deferred.
